candidate_selection: Execute both fixed calibration/holdout budgets. Select N4096 pipeline if its logical test passes, otherwise N16384 if its test passes, otherwise ABSTAIN. Never alter N or thresholds based on failures.
learner_access: Only local input/readout count tensors. No true rate, axis, output frame, physical noise record, exact source PTM or logical posthoc score enters frame fit or holdout decision.
source_family: Five stationary independent unknown-axis amplitude-damping channels followed by fixed unknown local rotations. Rational source definitions are in code_and_channels.py and belong only to generator/scorer.
known_code: [[5,1,3]] with XZZXI, IXZZX, XIXZZ, ZXIXZ; logicalX XXXXX, logicalZ ZZZZZ;16 known syndrome recoveries
interface: Ideal trusted source-state preparation, encoder, learned rational inverse unitary, known recovery, and final Pauli readout. Software simulation, not hardware gate compilation or fault tolerance.
physical_error_path_sampling: Physical amplitude-damping paths and code syndromes are analytically summed in the exact channel PTM. Individual input settings and final Born readout bits are sampled. Do not call internal jump/syndrome paths individually sampled.
comparators: Unencoded same learned local inverses on all five sites; ideal-frame same five-code as source-informed diagnostic. Equally informed standard five-code with identical calibration is exactly this algorithm, not a beaten competing method.
